name: error-destructure-negetive-test-6c1d1c393d/error_destructure_binding_pattern_error_cause-e.bal
spec_references: Statements: Destructuring assignment statement — Only supports [`wildcard-binding-pattern`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wildcard-binding-pattern)
reason: The expected compile error targets nested error destructuring in an assignment. Error binding patterns, including the nested cause pattern, fall outside the explicit wildcard-only destructuring restriction, even though the right-hand error constructors are supported.
unsupported_constructs: Error destructuring assignment with nested error cause binding pattern: error(errorMsg, error(errorCause))
test_design_notes: The @error marker asserts rejection; there are no @args, @panic, or @output assertions. The negative case depends on unsupported destructuring syntax.
